name: wise-writing
label: Write with a reproducible foundation
purpose: Scientific writing, reproducible documents, and review.
detail: Structure manuscripts, data reports, cruise reports, assessments, advice sheets, and benchmarks with shared writing conventions and Quarto templates.

name: wise-presentations
label: Turn a scientific story into slides
purpose: Scientific presentation planning, creation, and visual review.
detail: Plan the story, choose supported layouts, create reproducible scientific slides, and inspect the rendered presentation before delivery.

name: BAIT
label: Work with Biotic data locally
purpose: Access, preparation, analysis, and visualization of IMR Biotic data.
detail: Connect to local data, prepare survey catches, explore maps and life histories, and follow documented confidentiality and sampling rules.

name: index-wise
label: Build and evaluate survey indices
purpose: Development, validation, and reporting of survey indices using sdmTMB.
detail: Move from qualified survey observations to a first model, validation, sensitivity analysis, and an index report. Uses BAIT for Biotic data and wise-writing conventions.

name: spict-wise
label: Document a stock assessment
purpose: SPiCT stock assessments, diagnostics, sensitivity analyses, and advice.
detail: Prepare assessment inputs, fit and diagnose SPiCT models, explore alternatives, and produce reports and advice using wise-writing.

name: gadget-wise
label: Fisheries models with gadget3
purpose: A planned knowledge pack for developing fisheries models using gadget3.
detail: The repository is reserved for future development. No installable knowledge pack is available yet.

name: ggOceanMaps
purpose: Plot scientific data on ocean maps with bathymetry.

name: ggFishPlots
purpose: Estimate and visualize fish life-history relationships.
